titulo.en: Today I've eaten, yesterday I ate

intro.en: Two tenses for a finished action. In Spain the time word decides which one.

he ido.en: I have gone, I have been

texto.en:
In Spain the **perfecto** is used when the period is not over, or when no time is given.

- hoy, esta mañana, esta semana, este año, últimamente: **Esta mañana he desayunado** café.
- experience: alguna vez, nunca, ya, todavía no: ¿**Has estado** alguna vez en Perú?

The **indefinido** is used when the period is closed and cut off from now.

- ayer, anoche, el lunes, la semana pasada, el mes pasado, en 2019, hace un año: **Ayer desayuné** té.

A question about experience uses the perfecto, and the answer switches as soon as it gives a date: — ¿Has estado en Perú? — Sí, **fui** en 2019.

In most of Latin America, and in parts of Spain, the indefinido does both jobs: hoy desayuné café. You will hear both.

filas: la semana pasada, el año pasado

frases.en: Have you ever been to Peru?

frases.nota: The answer names a finished time, so it switches to the indefinido.

frases.es: Yo nunca he ido. Este año he viajado poco.
frases.en: I've never been. This year I haven't travelled much.

frases.es: Todavía no. Ayer comí a las cuatro.
frases.en: Not yet. Yesterday I had lunch at four.

pregunta.en: Complete, as in Spain: this morning I had coffee.

he tomado.en: Esta mañana still belongs to today, so the perfecto.

tomé.en: In Spain a period that includes now takes the perfecto.

tomaba.en: The imperfect would be a habit or a background.

pregunta.en: Complete: last week I went to the doctor.

fui.en: La semana pasada is a closed period.

he ido.en: The perfecto needs a period that is still open.

pregunta.en: Which time expression goes with the indefinido?

hace un año.en: A year ago is cut off from now.

todavía no.en: Not yet goes with the perfecto.

pregunta.en: «¿Has estado alguna vez en México?» Which answer is natural?

Sí, estuve en 2019.en: A finished year takes the indefinido.

Sí, he estado en 2019.en: With a closed date the tense is the indefinido.

bloques.frase: Este año he viajado muy poco

traduccion.en: This year I have travelled very little.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (60–80 words).** Write two paragraphs: what you have done today, and what you did the same day last week.

**Speak (about 1 minute).** Compare aloud this week with last week, choosing between he hecho and hice.
